parts.1:
Test Two. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1 Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Look at question one.
Question 1 One. How much did the girl pay for her trainers?
Boy: Those trainers are really cool, and they look expensive. I love them!
Girl: Thanks, I got them in the sale. They were seventy-five pounds fifty but I got them for only forty-seven ninety-nine. I was lucky.
Boy: You were. My brother's got some a bit like those, but they cost over fifty pounds, fifty-one seventy-five I think. Yours look much better.
Girl: Thanks. I'm glad you like them.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2 Two. Which picture does the boy choose for his grandmother?
Girl: Your photos are great, especially this one of the beach.
Boy: Thanks, I took them when I stayed with my grandmother last week. That picture of the castle's my favourite. I'm keeping all of them on my phone so I can show people.
Girl: Those flowers are beautiful.
Boy: My grandmother loves them. I'll print that photo for her. She wants to put it on her wall.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3 Three. What are they going to do first this afternoon?
Girl: What do we need to get now in the shopping centre?
Boy: I want to get that new board game. Will you play it with me later?
Girl: Of course. But hurry, we need to be back home for lunch. And Mum wants us to go on a bike ride after that.
Boy: OK, we'll play the game after the bike ride.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4 Four. What did the girl put on the pizza yesterday?
Girl: Mum and Dad loved the pizza I made for us all yesterday!
Boy: Did I have lots of mushrooms and onion on it? That's the kind I like.
Girl: We didn't have any mushrooms left, so I used tomatoes with the onion instead.
Boy: Good idea. My mum puts tomatoes with mushrooms. She doesn't really like onions, but I do.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5 Five. Which girl is the boy's sister?
Girl: I think I saw your sister this morning, at the dentist's. I love her long blonde hair.
Boy: Well, she's got long hair but it's dark. So, it wasn't my sister you saw.
Girl: Oh, OK. I thought it was strange that the girl in the dentist wasn't wearing glasses like your sister does.
Boy: Yeah, my sister can't see well without them!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2 Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6-10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a boy called Jake leaving a message for a friend about coming to his house to play computer games.
Jake: Hi. I'm really glad you can come round to my house this weekend to play computer games. Come on Sunday, as I have to do all my homework on Saturday.
I need to give you my address. It's number 51, Sherby Street. You spell that S-H-E-R-B-Y.
You can usually travel to my house by train, but the station nearest to my house is closed at the moment, so use the tram. It stops at the end of my road.
We want to have lots of time to play, so get here at quarter to two. I have to go out at half past four, so I'm afraid you'll need to leave then, too.
Could you bring something with you? Remember you borrowed my gloves that day when it was really cold? Can I have them back, please? You can keep the hat I lent you – I've got lots of those.
One more thing. Mum says you should give your parents her phone number. It's 05568 129437.
Right. See you soon!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3 Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11-15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear two friends, Emma and Jamie, planning a trip to a market.
Jamie: Is your mum driving us to the market on Saturday, Emma?
Emma: She's visiting my cousin. But we can go with Annie, who lives next door. She's really nice.
Jamie: Great! What time are we going?
Emma: We'll come to your house at quarter to eleven, Jamie.
Jamie: That's quite late.
Emma: Well, I've got my piano lesson until quarter past ten. I won't be ready to leave home before half past ten.
Jamie: OK. Do you want to get a dress for the school dance at the market?
Emma: I'm borrowing my friend Katie's actually, but I need to find a necklace and earrings to wear with it.
Jamie: I want to buy a toy for my brother's birthday.
Emma: The market's great for old computer games too.
Jamie: Yeah! They're ones you can't get in other places. You can get new ones anywhere.
Emma: Are they expensive?
Jamie: A little.
Emma: We can have lunch at the Moon Café later.
Jamie: They play very loud music.
Emma: Not really, Jamie! And the burgers are fantastic.
Jamie: That's true! But it's a shame the waiters never have time to chat.
Emma: They're always smiling!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4 Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16 Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about a party. Why couldn't the girl go to it?
Boy: Marco's party on Saturday night was great. It's a shame you missed it. Weren't you feeling well or something?
Girl: Actually, Mum was working late so I had to give Annie her tea and a bath.
Boy: Your baby sister?
Girl: Yeah. But after that I didn't just watch TV, I did my homework so then I was free on Sunday.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17 Seventeen. You will hear a teacher talking to a student called Danielle. What does he want Danielle to do?
Teacher: About your project, Danielle. I'm not really sure there's enough to write on the topic you've chosen, so I'd like you to choose something else to write about. I'm happy for you to have an extra five days to get it finished, although of course, if you're able to do it earlier, then give it to me when it's completed.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18 Eighteen. You will hear a boy talking to his friend about his new school bag. Why does he like his new bag?
Girl: Cool bag!
Boy: Maybe it's too bright! But my old one was really big because of all my books. Now I use my laptop, so I got one which was a better size for that.
Girl: You cycle to school, don't you?
Boy: Yeah. So it won't be as heavy as my old leather one.
Girl: Well, nobody will miss that colour when you go past!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19 Nineteen. You will hear a father leaving a message for his daughter. Why is he phoning his daughter?
Dad: Hi! It's Dad. Sorry, I can't meet you from school this afternoon. Your brother somehow caught the wrong train to get to his friend's house. He managed to get directions and finally arrived at his friend's, but I've offered to drive there and bring him back.
You'll have to get the bus home – hope you don't mind. I'll see you later.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20 Twenty. You will hear a girl talking about going to her first surfing lesson. How is she feeling about it?
Girl: It's my first surfing lesson tomorrow. I've done some surfing already with my friend, but she's not coming with me. That's no problem, but what if everyone's better than me – I don't want to feel embarrassed. I've checked the weather forecast and it's going to be windy, so there'll be some lovely big waves to practise on.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5 Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21-25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Carlos talking to his grandmother about the school sports teams he and his classmates are in. Which team is each person in?
Granny: Are there many sports teams at your school, Carlos?
Carlos: Yes, Granny. I wanted to be in the cycling team, but there weren't any places, so I joined the football team. It's fun.
Granny: And your sister Sofia? She's good at sports where you hit the ball, like hockey.
Carlos: Yeah, but it's the basketball team she plays for.
Granny: Oh. And what about your friend Aidan?
Carlos: He's bought a racket and loves using that, I was surprised, because he's tall enough to play basketball, but the team is full! Do you know my neighbour, Tina?
Granny: The one I sometimes see riding her bicycle?
Carlos: Yes. Well, she loves being in the pool. She wins lots of races.
Granny: That's good. And she has a brother, doesn't she?
Carlos: Yeah, Nick. The sports teacher wanted him to join the hockey team, but he prefers volleyball. He's really good at that.
Granny: And your friend Katrina?
Carlos: She joined a new team called 'Fast wheels'! It's perfect for her because she goes everywhere by bike. She wanted to be in the basketball team too, but she doesn't have time.
Granny: It's great that you all do sports.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 女孩实际支付了 £47.99，因此选择 A。她说明原价 "seventy-five pounds fifty"，但 "I got them for only forty-seven ninety-nine"；男孩提到哥哥那双 "cost over fifty pounds, fifty-one seventy-five I think"，是干扰信息。
explanations.p1q2: 男孩选择了祖母喜欢的花朵照片，因此选择 A。他说 "My grandmother loves them. I'll print that photo for her. She wants to put it on her wall."；海滩照和城堡照是他自己最喜欢的（"That picture of the castle's my favourite"），并不是要送给祖母的。
explanations.p1q3: 两人决定先骑自行车，因此选择 C。女孩提醒 "we need to be back home for lunch. And Mum wants us to go on a bike ride after that"，男孩随即答应 "OK, we'll play the game after the bike ride"，说明新桌游要排在骑车之后玩。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩在披萨上放了洋葱和西红柿，因此选择 C。她说 "We didn't have any mushrooms left, so I used tomatoes with the onion instead"；蘑菇当时已经用完，西红柿加蘑菇只是男孩妈妈的惯用做法。
explanations.p1q5: 男孩的姐姐是黑发并戴眼镜的女孩，因此选择 B。男孩纠正女孩说 "she's got long hair but it's dark"，又补充 "my sister can't see well without them!"（指眼镜）；牙医诊所里那位金发、没戴眼镜的女孩不是他姐姐。
explanations.p2q1: 杰克留言说 "It's number 51, Sherby Street. You spell that S-H-E-R-B-Y."，所以地址里缺的词是 Sherby。他特意逐字母拼读 S-H-E-R-B-Y，注意不要按常规拼法写成其他形式。
explanations.p2q2: 杰克说通常可以坐火车来，但 "the station nearest to my house is closed at the moment, so use the tram"，因此出行方式应填 tram；train 是被明确排除的干扰项。
explanations.p2q3: 杰克让朋友 "get here at quarter to two"，即 1.45（下午 1:45）到达，官方 Key 同时接受 quarter to two / 1/4 to 2 的写法；"half past four" 是他当天需要外出的时间，属于干扰信息。
explanations.p2q4: 杰克问 "Remember you borrowed my gloves that day when it was really cold? Can I have them back, please?"，所以要带来的是手套 gloves；他借出的帽子不用还（"You can keep the hat I lent you"），是干扰项。
explanations.p2q5: 杰克最后说 "Mum says you should give your parents her phone number. It's 05568 129437."，照抄这串号码即可；官方 Key 印刷为 05568 129437（空格分组）。
explanations.p3q1: Emma 的妈妈要去看表姐；住在隔壁的 Annie 可以带他们去市场。Emma 说 "She's visiting my cousin. But we can go with Annie, who lives next door."，所以开车送他们的是邻居 Annie，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q2: Emma 说会在 quarter to eleven 到 Jamie 家，即 10:45。原话是 "We'll come to your house at quarter to eleven, Jamie."；她钢琴课上到 quarter past ten、half past ten 前不离家，都是铺垫信息，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q3: Emma 已借到连衣裙，需要买项链和耳环搭配，所以选 jewellery。她说 "I'm borrowing my friend Katie's actually, but I need to find a necklace and earrings to wear with it."，连衣裙已经借到不用买，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q4: Jamie 说这些游戏在其他地方买不到，新游戏到处都有，因此它们很特别。原话 "They're ones you can't get in other places. You can get new ones anywhere."；Emma 问 "Are they expensive?"，Jamie 承认价格略高，可见他喜欢它们不是因为便宜，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q5: 两人都认可那里的汉堡很好吃；对服务员和音乐的看法并不完全一致。Jamie 抱怨 "They play very loud music."，Emma 回应 "Not really, Jamie! And the burgers are fantastic."，Jamie 也承认 "That's true! But it's a shame the waiters never have time to chat."；服务员没空聊天说明并不友好，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: 女孩缺席不是因为生病或作业，而是妈妈加班，她必须照顾妹妹 Annie。她说 "Mum was working late so I had to give Annie her tea and a bath."；男孩猜她 "Weren't you feeling well or something?" 被否定，作业是照顾妹妹之后才做的，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q2: 老师认为她选的主题没有足够内容可写，希望她换一个主题。原话 "I'm not really sure there's enough to write on the topic you've chosen, so I'd like you to choose something else to write about."；他还额外多给 "an extra five days"，并非要求提前完成，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q3: 新书包的大小更适合放笔记本电脑；颜色很亮但不是他喜欢它的原因。他说 "Now I use my laptop, so I got one which was a better size for that."；他自己都承认 "Maybe it's too bright!"，皮质只是旧书包的特点（"as heavy as my old leather one"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q4: 爸爸需要去接走错火车的弟弟，因此不能接女儿，打电话是说明这个问题。他说 "Your brother somehow caught the wrong train to get to his friend's house"，并且 "I've offered to drive there and bring him back."；问路是弟弟自己解决的（"He managed to get directions"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q5: 她不担心天气，朋友不来她也不介意；她担心其他人会比自己好，自己会尴尬。她说 "what if everyone's better than me – I don't want to feel embarrassed"；朋友不来她说 "That's no problem"，天气 "it's going to be windy, so there'll be some lovely big waves" 反而有利，因此选择 B。
explanations.p5q1: Sofia 在篮球队。Carlos 说 "Yeah, but it's the basketball team she plays for."，因此选 B（basketball）。Granny 猜她擅长 "sports where you hit the ball, like hockey"，只是猜测并被否定。
explanations.p5q2: Aidan 打网球。Carlos 说 "He's bought a racket and loves using that"，球拍对应 tennis，因此选 G。他虽然 "tall enough to play basketball, but the team is full"，篮球队满员去不了，basketball 是干扰。
explanations.p5q3: Tina 在游泳队。Carlos 说 "she loves being in the pool. She wins lots of races."，因此选 F（swimming）。Granny 只是 "sometimes see riding her bicycle"，骑车出行不等于参加自行车队，是干扰。
explanations.p5q4: Nick 选择排球。Carlos 说 "The sports teacher wanted him to join the hockey team, but he prefers volleyball."，因此选 H（volleyball）；hockey 只是体育老师想让他加入的队，并非他的选择。
explanations.p5q5: Katrina 参加自行车队。Carlos 说她加入了名为 'Fast wheels' 的新队，"It's perfect for her because she goes everywhere by bike."，因此选 C（cycling）；她 "wanted to be in the basketball team too, but she doesn't have time"，basketball 是干扰。
